nodes.name: Triggered by Hub (nps.promoter_flagged)
nodes.notes: Star topology S6.8: replaces the old 'Daily 10AM' independent poll. Hub-Dispatcher calls this workflow once per client on event_type = 'nps.promoter_flagged' (reported by Module 6.6). Unlike 6.5's multi-day cadence, this is a single-shot ask -- no safety-net poll needed, since Hub-Dispatcher/Hub-Intake own retry + error handling for the whole routing layer (see plan §0.3).

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM clients_master WHERE id = {{$json.client_id}} AND testimonial_ask_sent_at IS NULL;

nodes.name: Fetch Flagged Promoter by ID
nodes.notes: S6.8: was a bulk 'WHERE promoter_flag = true AND testimonial_ask_sent_at IS NULL' poll; now a single-row lookup by the client_id carried in the Hub event payload. The testimonial_ask_sent_at IS NULL guard is kept as an idempotency check in case the Hub-Dispatcher ever redelivers the same event. Milestone-completion trigger (KB Stage 52's second path) still not wired -- see README.

parameters.subject: Would you share a quick word about working with us?
parameters.text: ={{`Hi ${$json.name}, glad things are going well! Would you be open to a short testimonial we could feature? Just reply with a few lines -- no pressure at all.`}}

parameters.query: UPDATE clients_master SET testimonial_ask_sent_at = now() WHERE id = {{$json.id}};

nodes.name: Testimonial Reply Webhook (Postal Inbound)
nodes.notes: Reuses the same Postal inbound-reply pattern as Module 2.1's reply-tracking webhook -- filter subject/thread to this ask.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO case_studies (client_id, raw_reply, polished_quote, status, created_at)
VALUES ({{$json.client_id}}, {{JSON.stringify($json.body.text)}}, {{JSON.stringify($json.polished_quote)}}, 'pending_client_approval', now());

nodes.name: Odoo Discuss - Review Draft Alert
nodes.notes: Human approval gate -- per KB, client sign-off on final wording is always required before publishing. No auto-publish node exists in this workflow by design.
